scope: Pure demo policy; not backend acceptance

checks.name: Client-origin ticket accepts an agent; membership changes no lifecycle
Second expert channel is isolated
Internal question snapshots 12/24 calendar hours
Ordinary message and read cursor do not answer or extend deadline
Multiple individual questions use one ticket lifecycle
Read does not count as response; reminder has its own flag
One formal answer returns next turn to support while another stays open
Resume waiting reuses same question ID and deadline
Adding another participant while waiting does not restart timing
Reassignment preserves original recipient, sent time, deadline and question ID
Previous recipient cannot answer after reassignment
Internal question cannot be reassigned to client
Overdue does not close ticket even with main SLA paused
Reminder and overdue are recorded only once
Late formal answer remains valid and returns to support
Cancellation needs reason and records private audit
New question gets new independent deadline; current settings only affect new questions
Client questions do not adopt internal target or reminders
Agent own issue has no synthetic client or compulsory chat link
Author rework is capability-gated, not client-role-gated
No capability or expired resolution window denies author mutations
Closed business mutations denied; own read mark allowed
Internal settings reject ambiguous or reversed hours
